newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bonds close lower under Conf pressure.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bonds close lower under Conf pressure.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Swiss bonds ended lower in quiet trade and thin volume, under pressure from falling Conf futures. Professionals dominated trading with very few clients, dealers said.
* September CONF down 40 basis points to 120.40
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yields 3.411 pct vs 3.37 pct
